ui.settings.title: Settings
ui.settings.gpuUnknown: GPU: not readable in this browser
ui.settings.detectIdle: Recommendation from GPU name and processor cores (no benchmark).
ui.settings.sampleInGame: The sound sample is available during a match.
ui.settings.keyHint: Grid: letters build, Alt+letter issues orders, arrow keys move the camera. WASD: the camera moves on WASD. Windows: Alt+Shift can switch the keyboard layout.
ui.settings.rebind: Keys cannot be rebound in this version yet.
ui.settings.keys.buildText: The keys match the cards of the build card by position. The key is shown in the top left corner of each card.
ui.settings.keys.escape: Cancel placement or order, otherwise game menu
ui.settings.keys.alert: Jump to the latest alert (Shift: older alerts)
ui.settings.special: Alt+number: save group · right-click group: save · Shift+right-click: add · Ctrl+Del: self-destruct
ui.settings.hint: Settings are stored in this browser and apply immediately.
ui.settings.help.preset: Changes the related graphics values together.
ui.settings.help.renderScale: World resolution relative to the window.
ui.settings.help.splatLayers: Number of terrain textures blended together.
ui.settings.help.cameraShake: Camera motion from impacts and explosions.
ui.settings.help.audibleStall: A sound when mass or energy runs short.
ui.settings.help.audioInBackground: Keep sound when the tab is in the background.
ui.settings.help.keyScheme: Grid: letters build. WASD: letters move the camera.
ui.settings.help.uiScale: Size of the interface; Automatic follows the window height.
ui.settings.help.teamColors: Colours of houses on the map and in the interface.
ui.settings.help.reducedMotion: Fewer interface animations; System follows the operating system.
ui.settings.help.statePatterns: Patterns in addition to colours for states.
ui.settings.help.edgePan: Move the camera when the pointer touches the screen edge.
ui.settings.help.pauseInBackground: Pause the match while the tab is in the background.
ui.settings.help.autoSaveReplays: Keep the recording of every match in the replay library.
